name: Maiden's Folly Log
summary: The Maiden's Folly Log is the captain's record from a ship wrecked in Arathi's reef. Its pages and charts hold information Fleet Master Seahorn wants kept from prying eyes.

sections.title: A Wreck's Record
sections.body: First Mate Nilzlix seeks the log from the Maiden's Folly, wrecked alongside the Spirit of Silverpine. The ships ran aground on a reef temple after the tides began to fall, and sank quickly. Their records matter to the command in Booty Bay, which fears the information could reach enemy hands.

faq.q: What is the Maiden's Folly Log?
faq.answer: It is the captain's log from the Maiden's Folly, one of the ships wrecked in Arathi's reef.

faq.q: Where did the Maiden's Folly sink?
faq.answer: The Maiden's Folly ran aground on a reef temple in Arathi and sank.

faq.q: Why does First Mate Nilzlix want the log?
faq.answer: First Mate Nilzlix wants the Maiden's Folly's log and charts recovered before their information falls into enemy hands.

faq.q: What happened to the Maiden's Folly?
faq.answer: The tides began to fall as the Maiden's Folly approached a cove, and the ship ran aground on a reef temple before sinking.

faq.q: Who wants the records kept safe?
faq.answer: Fleet Master Seahorn's command in Booty Bay wants the logs and charts kept from prying eyes.
